title: Grey heron at the pond
note: Standing still in the reeds for twenty minutes, then took a small trout.

title: First frost on the moss
note: Thin white crust on the north side of every hummock; gone by noon.

title: Fly agaric ring
note: Seven caps in a rough circle under the birches, two already eaten into.

title: Redwings in the rowan
note: A flock of about thirty stripping the berries; very loud.

title: Arctic fox tracks
note: A line of prints across fresh snow, heading down towards the lava field.
